# ZVec.NET — LLM / agent documentation map

> PackageId: ZVec.NET (not NuGet "Zvec"). Native pin: zvec 0.7.0. SDK: 1.0.0-beta.6+zvec.0.7.0.
> Human site: https://ahmedSamir50.github.io/AdamSystems.ZVec.NET/
> Source: https://github.com/ahmedSamir50/AdamSystems.ZVec.NET
> Extra demos: https://github.com/ahmedSamir50/ZVec.Net-DemosAndPOCs

## Scope

- IN SCOPE: .NET SDK for Alibaba ZVec C API — DI, typed ODM, indexes, FTS, hybrid query, RIDs, binding gaps.
- OUT OF SCOPE: embeddings, MCP, skills, model rerankers, chat hosts (sample/demo apps may use them).

- Home: https://ahmedSamir50.github.io/AdamSystems.ZVec.NET/

- Examples (in-repo samples): …/examples/
- External demos/POCs: …/examples/demos-and-pocs/ → github.com/ahmedSamir50/ZVec.Net-DemosAndPOCs
- Concepts: …/concepts/
- Theory: …/theory/ (metrics, HNSW, IVF, Vamana, DiskANN, quantization, RRF)
- Native API coverage: …/reference/native-api-coverage/
- Package identity / versioning: …/reference/

## Upstream (product / theory)

- https://zvec.org
- Audit dump (local, gitignored): docs/llms-full.txt — metadata in docs/llms-full.meta.md

## Repo orientation for agents

- Managed SDK: src/Core/ZVec.NET/
- Native wrapper: src/Native/ZVec.Native/ (submodule external/zvec)
- Official hosts: samples/ (.NET 10; not in NuGet)
- External POCs: ZVec.Net-DemosAndPOCs (separate repo — do not vendor)
- Tests: testing/ZVec.NET.Tests/
- Contributor rules: CONTRIBUTING.md, AGENTS.md

## Known C API gaps (binding)

- HNSW-RaBitQ index create blocked; managed throws NotSupportedException.
- Group-by execution blocked (no zvec_collection_group_by_query in c_api.h).
- Next-release candidates (not bound): `zvec_collection_flush`, DiskANN `zvec_get_io_backend_*`. C++-only 0.7.0 (Turbo/uint7/uint8/HNSW original-vector) has no C API — do not invent bindings.
- See docs/reference/native-api-coverage.md and CHANGELOG `[Unreleased]` Planned.
